_readme: The smith explains the style system, and hands over the only healing item in the game.
The gift is on a CHOICE, never on a node: a node has no condition and no memory, so a
conversation looped through one would hand over a second pair of tonics. The idiom is
set_flag + hidden_if_flag on the same choice, which is how the hermit gives the oil.
Both replies END the talk. A choice line cannot be escaped with cancel - the box routes
input to the list, because the point of a choice is that one gets picked - so a
conversation that looped back through a choice would have no way out of it at all.

greet.speaker: Smith
greet.text: Every one of us was drawn by the same hand. Same palette, same outline, same ground under our feet.

point.speaker: Smith
point.text: Change the style and we all change together. That's the trick of it.

offer.speaker: Smith
offer.text: You have the look of someone walking east. Take these - bitter, but they close a cut mid-swing.

took.speaker: Smith
took.text: Drink one when you are losing, not after. That is the whole art.

manage.speaker: Smith
manage.text: Everyone says that. The shelf is here either way.
